hei.consejo: The h is a soft breath, as in English «hi».

trad.en: hello (also used when answering the phone)

ha det.consejo: In eastern speech, the final t of det is usually very weak.

jeg.consejo: The Norwegian j sounds like the y in «yes».

du.consejo: Round your lips as if saying «oo», but keep your tongue in the «ee» position. English has no exact equivalent.

hyggelig.consejo: The Norwegian y is said with rounded lips.

å.consejo: Its sound is like the vowel in English «go», but without the «w» sound at the end.

gjenta.consejo: The g at the beginning sounds like a soft «y», as in «yes».

unnskyld.consejo: The y is said with rounded lips; this is an approximation of eastern Norwegian.

går.consejo: Present tense of å gå; used in the expression «how's it going?».

og.consejo: The final g is often weak or silent in eastern speech.

ses.consejo: A common form in the goodbye «vi ses».

sju.consejo: It is also written «syv»; here we use «sju».
